title: Bleve search mapping changes are golden-file guarded
answers: How do I safely change the search index field mappings in unified storage?
Why did my search mapping change break a test with no obvious diff?
body: Changes to bleve field mappings (pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_mappings.go) are guarded by a golden-file test, search/bleve_mappings_golden_test.go. Regenerate expected output with the test's -update-golden flag and review the diff carefully; this file is effectively an on-disk index format contract, and unreviewed changes can silently break existing indices.
applies: Applies only to changes touching bleve field mappings/index schema; unrelated search logic changes don't need golden regeneration.
